$comment: Pinned dataset snapshots for the benchmark harness (gate G4). Raw data under raw/ is git-ignored; this metadata is the pin. Loaders in 03a read this manifest and must verify bytes against these hashes.

cord-v2.role: layout-stress bucket, out-of-language (DQ-04/ADR-010): Indonesian labels, never mixed into headline English accuracy
cord-v2.acquisition: six parquet files downloaded to raw/cord-v2/; sha256 of each verified against the Hugging Face LFS content identifier
cord-v2.labelCoverageNote: item name/quantity/unit price/line total + subtotal/total read from CORD menu structures; fields the parser does not support are excluded from scoring by the 03a loader, never null-scored
cord-v2.status: acquired: all six parquet files in raw/cord-v2/ verified byte-exact against these SHA-256 hashes (Hugging Face LFS content identifiers), 2.3 GB total

sroie.role: grand-total-only contract: company/date/address/total entities are the annotated scope; score total → grandTotal only, no item-level scoring
sroie.source: https://huggingface.co/datasets/jsdnrs/ICDAR2019-SROIE (community mirror of ICDAR 2019 SROIE, approved by owner 2026-11-02 — see DECISIONS/0002-sroie-snapshot.md)
sroie.license: CC-BY-4.0 as declared in the mirror's dataset card, LICENSE text, and NOTICE; the primary ICDAR host (rrc.cvc.uab.es/?ch=13, registration/consent) was NOT used and primary-source verification was NOT performed
sroie.acquisition: files downloaded to raw/sroie/; LFS oids verified byte-exact for both parquets and the sample image; plain files hash-pinned as fetched
sroie.labelCoverageNote: entities: company, date, address, total (string, extracted); words+bboxes layout present; the loader scores grandTotal only (total → grandTotal mapping)
sroie.status: acquired: all files in raw/sroie/ verified against the hashes above; community-mirror provenance caveat in DECISIONS/0002
